name: Middletown Plaza
summary: Middletown Plaza is a recently renovated 201,550 square foot community shopping center anchored by Trader Joe's, Petco, and Retro Fitness, prominently located on Route 35 with over 37,000 vehicles per day. The center completed a $7.7 million redevelopment in 2025 and serves an affluent trade area with average household incomes of $189,000, offering a strong mix of specialty retail, fitness concepts, and dining options.
demographics: Middletown Plaza serves an affluent and highly educated suburban market, with households within a 3-mile radius averaging $189,279 in annual income and 46% holding college degrees. The trade area population of approximately 62,427 residents within 3 miles consists primarily of upper-middle-class families and professionals who value quality retailers and specialty services. The daytime population of nearly 58,000 workers supplements the residential base, creating strong weekday traffic patterns. Shoppers are drawn to the center's mix of specialty fitness concepts, health-focused retailers like Trader Joe's, and family-oriented services, reflecting the area's wellness-conscious and family-centric lifestyle preferences.
description: Middletown Plaza is a premier 201,550 square foot community shopping center located at the highly visible northeast corner of Route 35 in Middletown Township, New Jersey, benefiting from over 37,000 vehicles per day passing the site. The center recently completed a comprehensive $7.7 million redevelopment in 2025, modernizing the property to better serve its affluent trade area where average household incomes exceed $189,000 within three miles. Anchored by the highly popular Trader Joe's specialty grocery store, along with Petco and Retro Fitness, the center offers a carefully curated tenant mix that includes SKECHERS, European Wax Center, Shake Shack, Club Pilates, and Nothing Bundt Cakes among its diverse roster of retailers and service providers. The property caters to the wellness-focused and family-oriented community with multiple fitness concepts including Retro Fitness, Club Pilates, Perspire Sauna Studio, and Satori Academy of Martial Arts, complemented by dining options ranging from Takumi Japanese Restaurant to The Milkshake Factory. Managed by Brixmor Property Group, one of the nation's largest owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, Middletown Plaza serves the highly educated population of Monmouth County within the greater New York-Newark-Jersey City metropolitan area.
